title: DaemonCatalog
description: What a delegation may name on this daemon, read when a client asks for the view Catalog: one row with the declared model routes (the view Routes with the prices and the wait the file declares), the runbooks a delegation may name as its protocol (the view Runbooks with their purpose, their inputs and the admission of their route entries) and the terms of a delegation. The daemon reads its file when it starts, the gateways as the view Routes does and the runbooks' files when the client asks; the language cannot read a file or a gateway, so no command creates or changes the row, as with Runbook.

routes.description: The declared routes, in order of name; none when the file declares none.

runbooks.description: The runbooks of the view Runbooks, in order of name.

sdc.daemon.CatalogId.title: CatalogId
sdc.daemon.CatalogId.description: The catalog as a row of DaemonCatalog: its text is the daemon's id. A type of its own, not DaemonId, because the row is what the daemon reads of its file, its gateways and its runbooks when a client asks, and not the configuration row.

sdc.daemon.CatalogRoute.title: CatalogRoute
sdc.daemon.CatalogRoute.description: A declared model route as the catalog lists it: what the view Routes says of it (the name, the gateway by name, the alias, the kind, the wires, the status, the phase and when the gateway was read, with the context length and the tool calling the gateway listed), and what the daemon's file declares of it beside its address: the prices and the wait, and the figures of the day of its wake cap as the view Routes answers them. No address, token or token file.

gateway.description: The name of the route's gateway in the daemon's file, never its address.

max_model_len.description: The context length `GET /v1/models` gave for the alias; absent when the gateway gave none.

tool_calling.description: Whether the model calls tools, as `GET /v1/models` gave it for the alias; absent when the gateway gave nothing.

price_in_micro_usd_per_mtok.description: What a call on the route books per million input tokens; absent when the file declares no price: the call books its reservation and its cost is not known.

price_out_micro_usd_per_mtok.description: The same per million output tokens.

start_wait_seconds.description: How long a run waits for the route's model to be ready; absent when the file sets none.

wake_booked_micro_usd.description: As in the view Routes: what the route's wakes booked on the day of the daemon's clock.

wake_cap_micro_usd.description: As in the view Routes: the route's wake_daily_cap_micro_usd.

wake_cost_micro_usd.description: As in the view Routes: the route's wake_cost_micro_usd.

wake_last_sent_at.description: As in the view Routes: the instant of the newest wake sent for the route.

wake_needed.description: As in the view Routes: a run waits on the route and the daemon sends no wake for it.

ceiling_refused_at.description: As in the view Routes: the instant of the day's newest spend-ceiling answer to a wake of the route.

pod_booked_micro_usd.description: As in the view Routes: what the pod's time of the route booked on the day of the daemon's clock.

read_at.description: When the daemon read the gateway for this route.

sdc.daemon.CatalogRunbook.title: CatalogRunbook
sdc.daemon.CatalogRunbook.description: A runbook a delegation may name as its protocol, as the catalog lists it: the name and version of the view Runbooks, its purpose in one line and its description as its root protocol gives them, the inputs a delegation's request fills, and its route entries with the daemon's admission of each. A runbook whose entries cannot be admitted is listed with the reason. No path of the host.

title.description: Its purpose in one line: the root protocol's title, else the first sentence of its description; absent when it has neither.

description.description: The root protocol's description, at most 2000 characters; absent when it has none.

inputs.description: The artifacts a delegation's request becomes: `idea` when the runbook's root bindings place it (the request is the run's intake); none when they place no idea, and such a runbook cannot take a request.

route_entries.description: One per role of its route entries file, by role; none when it has no such file: every declared route may serve it.

routes_allowed.description: The routes the file allows to serve the runbook; absent when it narrows nothing.

admitted.description: Whether every route entry is admitted and the file could be read.

refusal.description: Why the runbook's route entries cannot be admitted: the file's own fault, else the reason of each entry that is not admitted, joined by `; `. Absent when admitted.

sdc.daemon.ConfinementLevel.title: ConfinementLevel
sdc.daemon.ConfinementLevel.description: How strongly a run is sandboxed, weakest first: the runtime's names. local is not confined; linux is. oci and pod are the runtime's planned levels and are not in the set until it offers them. A submit that names no level runs at the daemon's default level (runbook serve --default-confinement, or `confinement` of runbook.toml); a daemon with none refuses the submit by name and writes nothing, as the binary has no built-in default; the handler fills it. The daemon's floor is linux unless it is started lower; the default is never below the floor, and a daemon whose default is below its floor does not start. local must be asked for by name or set as the default, and is refused under a linux floor.

sdc.daemon.DelegateMember.title: DelegateMember
sdc.daemon.DelegateMember.description: A member of the input of Delegate a client sends, as the OpenAPI document of the daemon gives it (the members the handler fills are left out).

summary.description: What the document says of it.

max_length.description: The most characters it may hold, where the document bounds it.

sdc.daemon.DelegationPath.title: DelegationPath
sdc.daemon.DelegationPath.description: How a delegation became a run (docs/model-routes.md, section 9): named (it named a protocol, and that runbook runs with the request as its intake), free (the free run, one agent node whose instruction is the request, writing result.md: asked for by the protocol delegation-free, or taken by a delegation that names no protocol on a daemon without a classifier route), classified (it named none, and one call on the classifier route picked a runbook of the daemon at or above the threshold of confidence, 0.8) or generated (the classifier's confidence was below it, and one call on the classifier route wrote a protocol of the daemon's parts, which the loader accepted) or change (it named a repository of the daemon's runbook.toml, `[repositories.<name>]`: the protocol delegation-change, one agent node working in the run's worktree of that repository, whose change the daemon commits and pushes as the branch runbook/<run-id> when the run delivers).

sdc.daemon.DelegationTerms.title: DelegationTerms
sdc.daemon.DelegationTerms.description: What a delegation on this daemon takes and where it goes: the members of Delegate, the paths a delegation may take here, the route of one that names none, the route of the classify and build calls, the level every delegation runs at and the most bytes of a request.

paths.description: named when the daemon can run a runbook the catalog lists; free when it runs the free run; on a daemon with a classifier route (`[route_policy] classifier`) also classified, when it lists a runbook, and generated, when it runs the free run whose agent node a built protocol runs. change when it runs the free run and its runbook.toml lists a repository (`[repositories.<name>]`). A daemon that lists none takes no delegation.

default_route.description: `route_policy.default`: the route of a delegation that names none; absent: a delegation must name one.

classifier_route.description: `route_policy.classifier`: the route of a delegation's classify and build calls; absent when the file names none.

confinement.description: The daemon's default level, the level of every delegation; absent: the daemon has none and refuses every delegation.

request_limit.description: The most bytes of a request: 1048576.

sdc.daemon.ModelRouteKind.title: ModelRouteKind
sdc.daemon.ModelRouteKind.description: What stands behind a route's alias at its gateway: managed (a model on a pod the gateway starts and stops), hosted (a fixed upstream, nothing started) or local (a model server on the gateway's machine, such as Ollama). The daemon's file says which; the daemon reads the status of a managed or a local route from the gateway, and sends a hosted route no call to probe it.

sdc.daemon.RouteEntry.title: RouteEntry
sdc.daemon.RouteEntry.description: One role of a runbook's route entries (the file `bindings/<runbook>.routes.yaml` of its runbook directory, format runbook.routes/1) and what the daemon's admission made of it: an entry that names a route is admitted when the daemon declares the route and the runbook's routes_allowed, when it has one, holds it; an entry that states needs is admitted with the daemon's default route when that meets them, else with the one allowed route that meets them, and none or several is a refusal.

role.description: The role the entry is for (writer, review, default, ...).

route.description: The route that serves the role: the one the entry names, or the route that meets its needs; absent when none does.

needs.description: The requirements of an entry that names no route; absent for an entry that names one.

reason.description: Why the entry is not admitted, naming the role and the route or the requirement; absent when it is.

sdc.daemon.RouteName.title: RouteName
sdc.daemon.RouteName.description: The name of a model route the daemon declares (a table [routes.<name>] of its runbook.toml): one to 64 characters of letters, digits, `.`, `_` and `-`. A client names a route by it, never by an address, a token or an alias; the address, the token file and the prices stay in the daemon's file.

sdc.daemon.RouteNeeds.title: RouteNeeds
sdc.daemon.RouteNeeds.description: What a route entry of a runbook asks of a route when it names none (docs/model-routes.md, section 2): each member that is present is a requirement, checked against what the route's gateway lists for its alias (`GET /v1/models`: the wires, max_model_len, tool_calling) and the route's kind in the daemon's file. A fact the gateway did not give does not meet a requirement.

wire.description: A wire the gateway lists for the alias: chat, responses or messages.

min_context.description: The least max_model_len the gateway lists for the alias.

tool_calling.description: true: the gateway lists tool calling for the alias.

sdc.daemon.RouteStatus.title: RouteStatus
sdc.daemon.RouteStatus.description: Where a route stands as the daemon last read its gateway: gateway-unreachable (no answer from `GET /ready` or `GET /v1/models`, or an address the daemon does not speak, https), gateway-not-ready (`/ready` answered, not 200, or `/v1/models` gave no list), model-unknown (the gateway is ready and `GET /v1/models` does not list the route's alias), ready or not-ready (the gateway read the route's model: `callable` of `GET /v1/status`, else the phase of `GET /v1/models/{alias}/status` for a managed or a local route, ready only for the phase ready), listed (the gateway is ready and lists the alias, and no status of the model was read: a hosted route on a gateway without `/v1/status`, or a status route that did not answer). A read sends no model call and starts nothing.

sdc.daemon.RunbookName.title: RunbookName
sdc.daemon.RunbookName.description: The name of a runbook in the list the view Runbooks gives: the text a client puts into the runbook_id of a SubmitRun. A type of its own, not RunbookId, because a row of that list names a runbook the daemon can start and is not a reference of a run to it.

sdc.daemon.RunbookVersion.title: RunbookVersion
sdc.daemon.RunbookVersion.description: The version of a runbook, as runbook list shows it. Optional in a submit: absent means the version the daemon has.
